conviction_note: The print turns on cash, not revenue. From the FQ1 10-Q, May-31 cash was $1.06M plus a CAD 3.5M ($2.54M) undrawn facility, against about $1.2M a quarter of operating burn, so Aug-31 liquidity should be about $2-2.6M with the facility partly drawn. The India JV debt was still at 'term sheets under review' in the 2026-10-01 deck, against a fall-2026 close given on the July call, and Loop's roughly $25M equity share is unfunded. The offsets are the 2026-09-17 strategic-alternatives committee and the chairman's fund building toward 10%. Five of seven prior prints fell, but the stock is already -45% since 2026-08-20 and at its 52-week low, so p_up is 40 rather than lower. abs_move is 13, from the 10.9% median reaction plus thin turnover. Findings sum -3.0 against a scaled -2.6: both negative and similar in size.
bar: Benzinga consensus for FQ2 FY27: revenue ~$330k, non-GAAP EPS -$0.05 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/LOOP/earnings-forecasts). This is ONE source, and the FQ1 bar was disputed ($612k vs $918k on two sources), so the bar is effectively unsourced and every reported-quarter finding is capped small. No company guidance exists. The line the stock actually trades on is liquidity and India funding, where there is no published bar.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest via Curved Trading (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/loop/short-interest/): 681.0K shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 4.3 days to cover, up from 562.5K on 09-15 (844.2K on 08-31 after the pump). That is about 1.4% of 48.4M shares outstanding and about 2.6% of the ~26M float (CEO Solomita holds ~22M per the 2026-10-01 deck): not crowded, so no squeeze haircut on negatives. Options: chain unusable (no two-sided ATM quotes, total OI 253, put/call OI 0.02), so there is no skew and no implied move. Tape: spot $0.351, -12.3% over 5 days, -34% over 20 days, 2.6% above the 52-week low. A 59.2M-share session on 2026-08-20 (open $0.89, high $0.98, close $0.645) was fully unwound.

findings.finding: Aug-31 liquidity will print near $2-2.6M, below Q1's $3.6M. May-31 cash was $1,063K plus the CAD 3.5M ($2,537K) undrawn bank facility. Q1 operating cash burn was $1,229K (cash overhead ~CAD 500k/month), the Investissement Québec loan calls for $599K of FY27 repayments, and no financing inflow has been filed since (EDGAR June-October shows no S-3, 424B or 1.01 financing). The cash line will be near zero, with the facility partly drawn, and the going-concern conclusion in the 10-Q ('will not be sufficient… substantial doubt') repeats with about two quarters of runway.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FQ1 FY27 (2026-07-14 amc): the stock fell 12.9% the next session on a revenue miss and a 'tightening cash position' (Chartmill: https://www.chartmill.com/news/LOOP/Chartmill-50975-Loop-Industries-NASDAQLOOP-Plunges-Over-11-After-Fiscal-Q1-Revenue-Miss-and-Tightening-Cash-Position). FQ2 FY26 (2025-10-15) fell 14.3%. Five of seven amc prints in the baseline fell.
findings.why_not_priced: The direction is public and the stock is -45% since 2026-08-20, so part of this is in the price. What is not printed is the number: no aggregator carries a quarter-end liquidity estimate, and the last figure the wire saw is $3.6M. If the market had priced a ~$2M liquidity line, the stock would not still be pricing a $17M company against a ~$25M unfunded JV equity commitment without a dilution discount. Financing question (lesson 4): no corroborated, funded ramp exists for the money to buy. The JV is pre-construction and the debt has not closed, so the shortfall is distress, not a ramp.
findings.independence: The quarterly burn rate comes from the Quartr call summary (https://quartr.com/events/loop-industries-inc-loop-q1-2027_FGkdZnvl): cash overhead about CAD 500k/month and a $1.23M operating outflow. The 2026-09-08 chairman release also repeats going-concern risk (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1504678/000143774926029827/ex_1013607.htm). This is arithmetic on the 10-Q, not a stated Aug-31 figure.

findings.finding: The India JV (ELITe) project debt had not closed as of 2026-10-01. The company deck filed that day still reads 'Project debt syndication underway with term sheets under review from several financial institutions', against the July 15 call's expectation of a close in fall 2026 aligned with groundbreaking. Loop's equity share (15% of a $165-170M project at 70/30 debt/equity, about $25M) remains unfunded against ~$1M of cash. Unless the release announces a close, the timeline slips another quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print with a debt-close announcement. Every print since the January 2026 'term sheets received' update has repeated 'progressing' wording and fallen (-3.4%, -3.0%, -12.9%).
findings.why_not_priced: The deck is public and nobody aggregates the slip against the July 'fall 2026' close target. If the market expected a close on this print, the stock would not have fallen 22% since the deck was filed. If a close IS announced on the print, this sign flips, which is why the band runs to +4.
findings.independence: Ester Industries' Q1 FY27 release (2026-08-12) and coverage of it mention only the offtake LOI and no loan sanction (https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/chemical/lite/ester-industries-posts-strong-q1-fy27-turnaround-as-revenue-rises-274-31506). The July timing is from secondary call coverage only (Seeking Alpha transcript, https://seekingalpha.com/article/4922307-loop-industries-inc-loop-q1-2027-earnings-call-transcript, not read in full).

findings.finding: There is a live strategic review with an aligned chairman. The board formed a Strategic Alternatives Committee on 2026-09-17, with a mandate running from project financing and strategic investment to sale, merger or going-private, and an immediate priority of funding the India equity. Chairman Jeff Geygan's GVIC bought at $0.64-0.73 on 07-31, 08-18 and 08-19 (3.36M shares indirect) and is 'scaling its ownership toward at least 10%' (2026-10-01 deck), from about 7%. The FQ2 release or call could carry an update or a transaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The committee announcement (2026-09-17) closed +10.1% ($0.484 to $0.533) on 569K shares, then gave it all back within two weeks.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades 34% below the committee-day close, so the market assigns little value to the review. If it were priced, the shares would hold a take-out or strategic-capital premium. The company said it will not comment further until the board approves a course of action, so an update on the print is optional and not dated. That is why it is sized small despite a wide upside tail.
findings.independence: GVIC's Form 4 purchases (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1504678/000119312526358148/xslF345X06/ownership.xml) and the 2026-10-01 deck slide 5 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1504678/000143774926031737/slide05.jpg) are separate documents pointing the same way.

findings.finding: FQ2 revenue will likely miss the ~$330k single-source consensus, and EPS likely misses -$0.05. FQ1 revenue was $179k, all India engineering services. The Germany (Schwarzheide) engineering contracts were said to start in September, after the Aug-31 quarter end, so FQ2 should again be India-only at about $150-250k. Net loss per share was -$0.07 in FQ1, carrying a 13% PIK dividend on the Series B ($375K/quarter) and rising stock compensation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FQ1 revenue of $179k against a $612-918k consensus: -12.9% the next session, alongside the cash line. Earlier revenue misses were -3.4% and -3.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus on Benzinga ($330k) sits well above the FQ1 run-rate, so the stale bar has not absorbed that Germany engineering starts after quarter end. The bar is single-source and the revenue is trivial against cash needs, so this is capped small (lesson 6).
findings.independence: The Germany engineering start of 'September' is from the Quartr Q1 call summary (https://quartr.com/events/loop-industries-inc-loop-q1-2027_FGkdZnvl). The Q1 release says Europe engineering revenue is expected 'this fiscal year' and gives no quarter. The bar is from https://www.benzinga.com/quote/LOOP/earnings-forecasts.

findings.finding: The former 5% holder Northern Private Capital (Lapham/Risley) sold in the open market below 5% on 2026-08-20 and still holds 2.27M shares (4.7%). That remaining stake is an overhang of about 18 days of 20-day average volume, now free of 13D reporting, and it can keep selling into any post-print strength.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on a print. The stock fell from $0.645 to $0.48 in the eight sessions after the 08-20 exit filing.
findings.why_not_priced: Holders below 5% no longer report, so their continued selling is invisible. On a ~$45k/day name, 2.27M shares (~$0.8M) is a lot of supply to absorb, and nothing in the price discounts it explicitly.

findings.finding: The selling into the print is heavy and unexplained by new company news. The stock is -45% from the 2026-08-20 pump session (59.2M shares, intraday high $0.98) and -34% over 20 days, with an 11.4% drop on 2026-10-13 and no filing or release since 10-09. It sits 2.6% above its 52-week low, in tax-loss season. A print without a new negative could meet exhausted sellers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's prior prints all came after smaller drawdowns. The one up print (+23.8%, 2025-05-29) followed a weak tape.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself, so by construction it is priced. Lesson 5 puts an unexplained microcap drawdown at 0. It is filed for the panel because the free control (-run_up) points the other way from the cash findings.

outside_window.finding: Nasdaq deficiencies: MVLS below $50M (Rule 5450(b)(2)(A)), deadline 2027-01-20, and bid below $1.00 (Rule 5450(a)(1)), deadline 2027-01-25. At $0.35 and ~$17M market cap, a reverse split or a transfer to the Capital Market is near-certain to be needed. Solomita's ~45% plus Series A votes make a split approvable.
Europe (Schwarzheide) engineering services revenue begins from September 2026, inside FQ3 (to Nov 30), which will be reported around January 2027.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the name's own reaction history (5 of 7 amc prints down, median |move| 10.9%) and cut against the free control, because the stock is -34% over 20 days and at its 52-week low. With no usable option chain there is no skew to agree or disagree with. That tension, together with the strategic-review tail, is why p_up is 40 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (single-source or disputed bar): the revenue/EPS reported-quarter finding was capped, -1.0 to -0.5.

Lesson 5 / 'what has worked' (documents beat arithmetic; an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the liquidity finding went -2.0 to -1.5 because the Aug-31 figure is arithmetic on the 10-Q, not a stated number; the drawdown/exhaustion positioning finding went +0.5 to 0.0.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what money is missing and for what. There is no funded ramp, a going-concern flag and an unfunded JV equity commitment, so the liquidity finding stays negative.

Lesson 1 / 'least priced is not most likely right': the strategic-review finding went +0.75 to +0.5, because the company said it will not comment until the board approves a course, so there is no dated mechanism inside the window.
India debt-close finding went -1.5 to -1.0, because the Oct-1 deck that shows the slip is public (partly priced); its band is kept wide because a close announced on the print flips the sign.
Lesson 7: short interest checked (681K, ~2.6% of float, 4.3 days), so no squeeze haircut on the negatives. The scaled number (abs 13, p_up 40) is unchanged by the file.
